title: Broken Buckets
description: After serving 17 years in prison, Travis Cane returns home to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family. But his once bright son, Dontae is acting out and abandons his goals in basketball for a life on the streets.

title: Three of a Kind
description: Three years after graduation, college friends Hope, Chanta and May eagerly reunite for Hope's wedding to her fiancé, Robert. As the weekend unfolds, a secret emerges. When the truth comes to light, the celebration descends into chaos.

title: The Good Sister
description: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

title: Trapped in the Game: Fool Me Once
description: Dallas Bush is assigned to take down a powerful drug lord, when he learns the payout could cover his dying mother's medical bills. Dallas must navigate a dangerous web of deception, crime, and moral compromise, where every choice comes with a price.

title: Too Much, Too Soon
description: Based on the autobiography of Diana Barrymore (Dorothy Malone), the troubled daughter of actor John Barrymore (Errol Flynn).

title: If I Can't Have You
description: Marc, a married man, embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife.

title: Deadly Surrogate
description: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

title: Hated by Many, Loved by None
description: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life.

title: But I'm Married
description: Kimora and Jamal's seemingly perfect marriage falters. Seeking to reignite passion, Kimora explores unconventional options, including a third person. This decision unleashes a web of lies and betrayal, forcing Kimora to confront hidden desires.

title: All the love
description: A young woman begins her journey to adulthood, navigating love and self-discovery, while being haunted by a mysterious past that she can't fully remember. As murders and violence swirl around her, she wonders who she can trust.

title: The Perfect Mother
description: Linda, a determined mother, faces the daily struggles of raising her son amidst the unpredictable presence of her husband. When a series of hardships push her to the edge, Linda's plea for assistance leads to Ahmad being taken into CPS custody.

title: The Price of Fame
description: Cassie, a young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry.

title: Reality TV Murders
description: Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show "Diva's Doing it'." When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of them would literally kill to be famous.

title: American Girl
description: A determined 19-year-old girl escapes her toxic stepfather in rural Georgia, embarking on a challenging journey to survival on the streets of Atlanta.

title: No Conscience
description: After years of being taken advantage of by men, Yanni flees to Atlanta to seek refuge with her best friend and her ex-con boyfriend.

title: Suffocated
description: Lexxy believes she finally found a man who can be her husband and the father to her child, but he takes her on a ride of lies and betrayal.

title: Double Standards 2
description: When Pastor Noble Jones's carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface-ranging from infidelity, hidden.

title: Her Last Patient
description: Dr. Athena Hart thought she had seen every kind of broken soul-until Lucas Morningstar walked into her office. What begins as therapy quickly twists into a deadly game of obsession and revenge.

title: Buried
description: After fleeing under a new identity following a suspected double murder, a man's quiet life in Florida unravels as neighbors probe his past.

title: ToxiCity
description: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order.

title: Why Not You
description: Mario, a young dancer living in his small village, has to face the loss of his beloved friend Lenz, a victim of an attack in a gay club.

title: The Sermon
description: When a charismatic pastor's sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

title: Blood or Not
description: Ten years with a squeaky clean record on the force, detective Ben Tucker isn't about to let his gangster brother Mike take it all away.

title: Scarred
description: Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate's wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.

title: Rhythm and Revenge
description: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her.

title: Broken Buckets
description: After serving 17 years in prison, Travis Cane returns home to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family. But his once bright son, Dontae is acting out and abandons his goals in basketball for a life on the streets.

title: When It Rains
description: While Todd is away at graduate school to better his family, his wife is back home taking care of her sick mother. The distance takes a toll on their marriage, and Todd meets the beautiful Sharon at a bar.

title: Apex
description: A special ops team enters the underground bunker "Hades" to rescue missing scientists, only to uncover a terrifying secret far beyond their expectations.

title: EscapeCation
description: A group of friends becomes trapped in a smart home and is forced to play twisted games to escape.

title: The Wrong Man
description: In the wake of a devastating loss, a widowed mother is left to navigate the complexities of life with her two children. She is determined to provide stability and find love again. New love is sometimes not what it seems.

title: A Wonderful Lie
description: Fading romance author Rebecca Sinclair concocts a desperate plan to reignite her dwindling career and fractured marriage. She creates a web of lies and her twisted plot leaves her trapped in a nightmare of her own making.

title: Trouble
description: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecelius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into something dangerous.

title: Reality TV Murders
description: Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show "Diva's Doing it'." When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of them would literally kill to be famous.

title: Bloodlines
description: Sydney is a college student that has always felt out of place. When she learns she's adopted, her world beings to unravel, and she embarks on a journey to discover her origins, but they come at a cost, and could destroy everything she's ever known.

title: Crash Out
description: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off; they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

title: Grave Secrets
description: After visiting their late mother's grave, Monica Anderson and her younger sister Angie try to settle back into a quiet evening at home. Their peace is shattered when news of a local serial killer breaks, and a shadowy figure begins stalking them.

title: Deadly Squatters
description: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find two siblings have taken up residence in their home, and are claiming legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with strangers, they must figure out how to get out of their own home alive.

title: The Lineup
description: Sebastian "Bas" Monte is an up-and-coming influencer and club promoter. He doesn't have the time to commit to only one woman, so he schedules out different women for his needs. That is until he meets Mikayla, and he questions his playboy ways.

title: Then There Was You
description: Lady's man Kingston gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Shandre, a spoken-word artist who introduces him to a lifestyle deeply rooted in African American culture.

title: When Love Comes Knocking
description: Veronica Richardson, a girl who has never been with a good man, is caught off guard when true love finds its way to her doorstep. It is up to her if she wants to let it in or shut it out.

title: The Good Sister
description: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

title: Shotlanta
description: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, immigrates to Atlanta. Determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path.

title: One More Day
description: A single mother and her 15-year-old daughter's relationship is strained as the mother's career grows.

title: Pretty Girls Kill
description: In 2004, Ruby, a college student witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty.

title: The Forsaken
description: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life...

title: How Did We Get Here
description: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity.

title: The New Girl
description: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister.

title: Trouble
description: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecelius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into something dangerous.

title: The Last Eyewitness
description: After a violent money exchange in a remote forest leaves several people dead, Riley becomes the only witness to a ruthless crime boss's return. Hunted through the wilderness, she must outlast her pursuers to survive.

title: Don't Push That!
description: Three coworkers stumble upon a device labeled DPT that can create the worst possible outcome of any action or decision. Once the button on the device is pressed, it must be pressed every 11 minutes to prevent further destruction.
